body.x: Nurimaru introduced "Booto Clean Humidifier" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Nurimaru is a company that makes lifestyle electronics with great function and design. This humidifier is very easy to disassemble and clean, not having to worry about the emission of harmful substances. It is energy-saving and very easy to use.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
